independently_located_designs.source_reading: Re_tau=323, imposed mean pressure gradient magnitude 16 in both Newtonian n=1 and shear-thinning n=.6 periodic pipes. Newtonian WMLES 1–5 compare algebraic WW at sampling cell 3, integrated WW at cell 1 and underresolved no-slip; matched sample heights near 30 or 60 can require different wall cells/grids. Mean U, radial/azimuthal/streamwise rms and Reynolds shear are measured against WRLES; DNS target U_b=31.86 Newtonian and 34.46 shear-thinning. Eq. 48 fixes mean wall stress. Non-Newtonian WMLES 6–22 have separate free bulk-velocity errors (Table 4). Figs. 15–16 explicitly vary near-wall viscosity closure at h+=60, n_s=3 with other parameters fixed.
independently_located_designs.scientific_effect: A paper-wide non-Newtonian exclusion misses a smooth Newtonian WMLES system benchmark. Avoid treating the imposed mean stress as a successful prediction, or Newtonian WW pairs with changed mesh as a clean wall-only test. The within-NNODE comparisons are controlled in their own non-Newtonian stratum.
